title: Bias of a proper affine subspace density
statement: Let $H$ be a proper linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $b$'s field with two elements, let $a$ be a vector in that space, and let $b$ be a real number with $b<1$. The uniform density on the affine subspace $a+H$ is not $b$-biased; that is, some nonzero vector has a Fourier coefficient whose absolute value exceeds $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A subspace $H$ of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$ with $H\ne\mathbb F_2^n$
